استرجمت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْجَمْتُ (istarjamtu) /is.tar.d͡ʒam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# اِسْتَرْجَمْتَ (istarjamta) /is.tar.d͡ʒam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# اِسْتَرْجَمْتِ (istarjamti) /is.tar.d͡ʒam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# اِسْتَرْجَمَتْ (istarjamat)
